Denial now resolves the slot to explicit Null: dropped the .or_else host-input fallback in the LoadHost cookie arm (crates/plec-eval/src/eval.rs) so a denied sync cookie read can never resolve from app.host_inputs. Chose Null over Err propagation: denial is default-deny 'no value' (same shape as a missing slot), stays observable as an empty render, and does not fail the whole mount — preserving the documented SSR server-gating flow where an ungranted runtime renders empty and the server decides content. Err propagation would break existing denied-read wasm tests and the SSR-gating acceptance E2E. Regression test sync_cookie_denial_does_not_fall_back_to_seeded_host_inputs (crates/plec-runtime/tests/typed_events.rs) covers both denial modes (no policy; policy without getSync) with host_inputs seeded under the cookie name, asserting empty output.
